description: A 1-deep pit of powder snow (x 4 to 8): walk in (sinking and slowed) and on against its far side, then hold jump there (no way out without boots); fall into it from 6 blocks up (caught by the falling shape, then sinking); in leather boots walk onto its top and along it, sneak to sink in, then walk against the far side and climb out onto the ground beyond.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
